name: Tours-sur-Marne

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this cool ripen Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, Müller-Thurgau, Pinot Gris and Gewürztraminer fully without cooking off their freshness.
Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Chalk is soft, porous limestone. Roots push deep into it, and it drains well while still storing water. It is planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its high pH can starve vines of iron and yellow the leaves, so growers plant lime-tolerant rootstocks.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Only very early grapes ripen well, mostly hybrids and a few vinifera.
